rules.sentence: The clinical course of cystitis cystica is undetermined, though removing the source of the irritation can cause the cystic inflammation to regress.
Successful treatment and prevention of UTIs can lead to the disappearance of mucosal changes.[23][72][73]

The malignant potential of cystitis cystica remains controversial; however, some anecdotal cases have been reported of cystitis glandularis and nephrogenic adenoma turning into adenocarcinoma.[17][18][19][20][21][22]
Cystitis glandularis intestinal type with dysplastic histology most likely still requires periodic cystoscopic surveillance, while other cystitis cystica and cystitis glandularis probably do not.
